description: This app will inform astronauts and provide information resources to help them manage their health inside the spacecraft. It will provide a system that lets people in space communicate with doctors on Earth, as well as monitor things such as heart rate, blood pressure, and temperature.
summary: This app lets astronauts communicate with medical care workers on Earth just by a click of a button. Health care in space is extremely important, and letting astronauts see their blood pressure, heart rate, and body temperature not only helps them understand their needs but also helps qualified doctors on Earth that can provide help and feedback towards their health. With a quick log-in system, this app is important because it highlights modern technology and makes sure space workers are getting the care they need.
details: Healthcare in Space is an app designed to keep astronauts healthy and safe during space missions. It allows them to monitor their heart rate, blood pressure and body temperature using wearable sensors. The sensor collects data and sends it to the app. Early detection of health concerns facilitates easier access to medical support. Making space missions safer improves astronaut health care. Wearable sensors, tablets. Databases will be used.
